subject: POC benchmark — scheduling & test harness sync
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@greenbeta.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@solvercorp.com>
Date: Thu, May 3, 2028 at 09:14 AM -0700
Subject: Request to move POC benchmark window (May 6)

Hi Tessa —

Quick note: we just had a product planning conflict push our on-site demo on May 6 into the same afternoon as the scheduled benchmark run. Would you have availability to move the hands-on/benchmark session to either the morning of May 7 or the afternoon of May 8?

We want to keep the session focused: prompt review (30m), routing/kv cache discussion (20m), and a 60–90m load run to validate throughput. Our primary goal is to validate a sustained throughput target of ~800 rps with p95 latency under 400ms. If we need to trim time, we can run a single focused load against a representative prompt set.

Also, can your team share the test harness instructions and any Docker images we should pull ahead of time? Attendees will be myself (Sam), Emily (SRE lead), and our performance engineer Mark Rivera.

Thanks —
Sam
Principal Product at GreenBeta AI

Attachment: poc-testplan.pdf (overview)
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@greenbeta.ai>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@solvercorp.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, May 3, 2028 at 10:02 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move POC benchmark window (May 6)

Thanks for the heads up, Sam — we can accommodate.

Option 1: Tue May 7, 08:30–11:00 PT (morning slot)
Option 2: Wed May 8, 13:30–15:30 PT (afternoon slot)

Proposed agenda (90m):
- 08:30 / 13:30 — quick intros & success criteria (10m)
- Prompt set walkthrough and prompt-routing notes (20m)
- Test harness & fixture review (15m)
- Load run and live monitoring (40–50m)
- Wrap + next steps (5–10m)

Vivek will lead the test harness and will need 30m at the start to confirm environment (KV cache warm-up, batching config). Marissa will coordinate calendar invites and prerequisites.

We’ll share the harness repo and a short prep doc. I’m attaching the short testplan and a checklist; Vivek, can you confirm the Docker image tag and any env vars we expect them to set?

If either option works for you, say which and I’ll send an invite with the runbook and the Zoom link.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: load-harness-instructions.md (stub)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@greenbeta.ai>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@solvercorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, May 3, 2028 at 11:18 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move POC benchmark window (May 6)

Quick tech notes —
- Docker image: redwood/load-harness:20280501-poc (public pull)
- Default envs: REDWOOD_MODEL=rbx-3b, SEQ=1024, BATCHER_AUTOTUNE=true
- KV warm-up: run a 5-minute prefix warm-up at 200 rps before the main run
- Measurement: we’ll capture p50/p95/p99 and 95th-tail CPU on the serving nodes

If the target is 800 rps sustained, we should plan for a 90-minute window so we can do a ramp (10m), steady-state (60m), and cool-down (20m). That lets us catch variance and tail spikes.

Sam — can Mark share the preferred prompt mix (tokens per request, example sizes)? If the prompts are >800 tokens on average, we’ll need to adjust expectation for tokens-per-second vs requests-per-second.

I’ll attach a short runbook snippet and a sample `wrk` command we’ll use.

— Vivek
Senior Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-bench-results.csv (example outputs)
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@greenbeta.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@solvercorp.com>, Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@greenbeta.ai>
Date: Fri, May 4, 2028 at 08:22 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move POC benchmark window (May 6)

Thanks, Tessa and team — Option 2 (Wed May 8, 13:30–15:30 PT) works best for us. Confirming attendees: Sam (me), Emily (SRE), Mark Rivera (Perf).

Mark shared the prompt mix: 70% short (avg 120 tokens), 20% medium (avg 420 tokens), 10% long (avg 1,200 tokens). We’re primarily interested in request-level throughput target of 800 rps. If tokens-per-second becomes limiting, please call it out — we expect trade-offs.

A couple of asks before the run:
- Please share the exact `wrk` command and any header signing steps we need.
- We’ll upload our traffic fixture to the shared Drive folder; please confirm the path you’ll pull from.
- Can you enable a canary/smoke run against a single replica first to validate correctness, then scale to full load?

Appreciate it — see you Wed.

— Sam

All set for Wed May 8, 13:30–15:30 PT — calendar invite sent.

Pre-call checklist (please complete by Tue EOD):
- GreenBeta: upload traffic fixture to Drive folder `1a2b3c-poc-docs/fixtures/` (Sam/Mark)
- GreenBeta: confirm any auth headers or API keys we should accept for the run (Emily)
- Redwood: pull `redwood/load-harness:20280501-poc` and validate local run (Vivek)
- Redwood: share `wrk` command and `env` snippet in the Drive runbook (Marissa)
- All: ensure Zoom numbers and monitoring access are working (we’ll add Prometheus and Grafana read-only links to the runbook)

Success criteria reminder: sustained ~800 rps with p95 < 400ms on the representative prompt mix. If we see token-bound throughput, we’ll pivot to tokens/sec targets and record regression notes.

If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the run.
